name: haalving
description: HAALVING — Blue Zones way-of-living platform. Team Console (web), Client app (mobile), API (backend).
//dependencies: React is declared here, at the hoisted root, on purpose. The workspace holds two Reacts — the console on 19, the Expo app on 18.3 (the pair Expo SDK 52 ships). With node-linker=hoisted, whichever wins the root is shared by everything that doesn't nest its own; when React 18 won it, styled-jsx (a Next internal) ended up with a SECOND React 19 copy, a different module instance from the one react-dom renders with, and `next build` crashed prerendering /404 with a null useContext dispatcher. Pinning React 19 at the root makes it the one shared instance for next, styled-jsx and the web app; react-native still nests its own 18.3 because its peer range excludes 19.
